2.t: Because there came to him the blind man (interrupting).

3.t: But what could tell thee but that perchance he might grow (in spiritual understanding)?-

4.t: Or that he might receive admonition, and the teaching might profit him?

5.t: As to one who regards Himself as self-sufficient,

7.t: Though it is no blame to thee if he grow not (in spiritual understanding).

8.t: But as to him who came to thee striving earnestly,

11.t: By no means (should it be so)! For it is indeed a Message of instruction:

12.t: Therefore let whoso will, keep it in remembrance.

13.t: (It is) in Books held (greatly) in honour,

14.t: Exalted (in dignity), kept pure and holy,

17.t: Woe to man! What hath made him reject Allah;

18.t: From what stuff hath He created him?

19.t: From a sperm-drop: He hath created him, and then mouldeth him in due proportions;

20.t: Then doth He make His path smooth for him;

21.t: Then He causeth him to die, and putteth him in his grave;

22.t: Then, when it is His Will, He will raise him up (again).

23.t: By no means hath he fulfilled what Allah hath commanded him.

24.t: Then let man look at his food, (and how We provide it):

25.t: For that We pour forth water in abundance,

26.t: And We split the earth in fragments,

30.t: And enclosed Gardens, dense with lofty trees,

32.t: For use and convenience to you and your cattle.

33.t: At length, when there comes the Deafening Noise,-

34.t: That Day shall a man flee from his own brother,

35.t: And from his mother and his father,

36.t: And from his wife and his children.

37.t: Each one of them, that Day, will have enough concern (of his own) to make him indifferent to the others.

38.t: Some faces that Day will be beaming,

40.t: And other faces that Day will be dust-stained,

42.t: Such will be the Rejecters of Allah, the doers of iniquity.
